subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS073]
text: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS073] is found in the southern tunnel from the bottom level of the central chamber with the tower, requiring Iron Boots.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #1 [GS073]
Found: In southern tunnel, from the bottom level of the central chamber with
the
       tower
Requires: Iron Boots

subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS073]
text: Head down the southern tunnel on the bottom level of the central chamber to the grating, and use a Super Spin Attack to activate the crystal switch on the other side to reach the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Head down the southern tunnel on the bottom level of the central chamber.  Head
towards the end of the tunnel, and when you reach the grating, use a Super Spin
Attack to activate the crystal switch on the other side.  The Gold Skulltula is
on the other side of the grating.

subject: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS074]
text: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS074] is found in the river rapids room on the wall after the second turn, requiring Iron Boots and Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #2 [GS074]
Found: In the river rapids room, on wall after second turn
Requires: Iron Boots; Longshot

subject: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS074]
text: Head downstream, equip the Iron Boots after the second corner, and kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall near the corner to take the token with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Head down stream, and after the second corner equip the Iron Boots and use the
Longshot to kill the Gold Skulltula from the wall near the corner.  Take the
token with the Longshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS075]
text: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS075] is found at the very top of the central tower, requiring the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #3 [GS075]
Found: In the central tower, at very top of the tower
Requires: Longshot

subject: Central Tower Door
text: Light the unlit torch on the second level of the tower using a Fire Arrow or by shooting an arrow through the nearby lit torch to unseal the door to the tower.

evidence.quote:
Light the unlit torch on the second level of the tower using either a Fire
Arrow, or by shooting an arrow through the nearby lit torch and into the unlit
torch.  The door to the tower will unseal itself.

subject: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS075]
text: Go through the unsealed door, look on the ceiling above to spot the Gold Skulltula, then kill it and take its token with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Go through it, and look on
the ceiling above to see the Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token with
the Longshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula #4 [GS076]
text: Gold Skulltula #4 [GS076] is found in the room with the waterfall and rising Longshot targets, requiring the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #4 [GS076]
Found: In the room with the waterfall and rising Longshot targets
Requires: Longshot

subject: Gold Skulltula #4 [GS076]
text: From the central room, go to the top level and through the west door, look on the right wall to find the Gold Skulltula, and use the Longshot to kill it and collect its token.

evidence.quote:
From the central room, go to the top level and go through the west door.  Look
on the right wall as you enter the room to see the Gold Skulltula.  Use the
Longshot to kill it and take it's token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #5 [GS077]
text: Gold Skulltula #5 [GS077] is located behind the waterfall in the tunnel immediately before the Boss Key, requiring the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #5 [GS077]
Found: Behind waterfall in tunnel immediately before the Boss Key
Requires: Longshot

subject: Gold Skulltula #5 [GS077]
text: Kill the Gold Skulltula behind the waterfall with the Longshot, then retrieve its token with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Gold Skulltula behind the waterfall using the Longshot, then take it's
token with the Longshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS080]
text: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS080] is found behind the locked door in the left side of the center area, requiring a Small Key and Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #1 [GS080]
Found: Behind the locked door in the left side of the center area.
Requires: Small Key; Boomerang

subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS080]
text: Use one of the dungeon's three keys to open the locked door, watch out for flying pots and Fire Keese, kill the Gold Skulltula in the room, and take its token with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Use one of the three keys in the dungeon to open the locked door.  Kill the
Gold Skulltula in the room, and watch out for flying pots and fire keese.  Take
the token with the Boomerang.

subject: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS079]
text: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS079] is found behind the locked door in the right side of the center area, requiring a Small Key, Boomerang, and optionally the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #2 [GS079]
Found: Behind the locked door in the right side of the center area.
Requires: Small Key; Boomerang; Lens of Truth Optional

subject: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS079]
text: Use one of the three dungeon keys to open the locked door, use the Lens of Truth to see the invisible platforms over the pit in the room's center, and kill the Gold Skulltula on the other side to take its token with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote:
Use one of the three keys in the dungeon to open the locked door.  Use the Lens
of Truth to see the invisible platforms that extend over the pit in the middle
of the room.  On the other side of the platforms, kill the Gold Skulltula and
take it's token with the Boomerang.

subject: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS081]
text: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS081] is located behind the locked door in the northwest corner of the dungeon, requiring a Small Key and Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #3 [GS081]
Found: Behind the locked door in the northwest corner of the dungeon.
Requires: Small Key; Lens of Truth

subject: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS081]
text: Go through the northwest crawlspace in the main area, unlock the door, use the Lens of Truth to avoid pits while watching for Fire Keese and the Beamos, then enter the next door to defeat the Like-Like, kill the Gold Skulltula, and retrieve its token.

evidence.quote:
Go through the crawlspace in the northwest corner of the main area of the
dungeon.  On the other side, go through the locked door on the other side, and
use the Lens of Truth to safely traverse the next room and avoid the pits.
Watch out for Fire Keese and the Beamos.  Go through the door on the other side
of the room, kill the Like-Like, then kill the Gold Skulltula and take it's
token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS082]
text: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS082] is found in the first room with the invisible spinning scythes, requiring the Hookshot or Longshot and optionally the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #1 [GS082]
Found: In the first room with the invisible spinning scythes
Requires: Hookshot OR Longshot; Lens of Truth Optional

subject: Gold Skulltula #1 [GS082]
text: Kill all enemies in the room while dodging the invisible scythes to retract the grating, then kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall behind it and take its token with the Hookshot or Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Kill all of the enemies in the room while dodging the invisible scythes, and
the grating in the room will retract.  Go behind the grating, and kill the Gold
Skulltula on the wall.  Take it's token with the Hookshot/Longshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS083]
text: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS083] is found in the room with the crushing ceilings and requires nothing.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #2 [GS083]
Found: In the room with the crushing ceilings
Requires: Nothing

subject: Gold Skulltula #2 [GS083]
text: Use the hidden stone block to block the crushing ceilings, enter the cell hiding the Gold Skulltula, kill it, and collect its token.

evidence.quote:
Use the stone block hidden in the room to block the crushing ceilings.  The
Gold Skulltula is hidden in one of the cells in the room.  Enter the cell, kill
the Skulltula and take it's token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS084]
text: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS084] is found behind the flaming skull in the room with the single flaming skull, requiring the Hookshot or Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #3 [GS084]
Found: Behind the flaming skull in the room with the single flaming skull
Requires: Hookshot OR Longshot

subject: Gold Skulltula #3 [GS084]
text: In the room with the single flaming skull, kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall behind the skull and take its token using the Hookshot or Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Find the room with the SINGLE flaming skull.  The Gold Skulltula is on the wall
behind the flaming skull.  Use the Hookshot/Longshot to kill it and take it's
token.

subject: Gold Skulltula #4 [GS085]
text: Gold Skulltula #4 [GS085] is found in a high-up alcove in the room with the ship, requiring the Longshot and optionally Scarecrow's Song.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #4 [GS085]
Found: In a high-up alcove in the room with the ship
Requires: Longshot; Scarecrow's Song Optional

subject: Gold Skulltula #4 [GS085]
text: Climb up to the front of the ship to shoot the Gold Skulltula in the high alcove with the Longshot to take its token, or play the Scarecrow's Song to pull over to the alcove.

evidence.quote:
Head for the room with the ship, and climb up to the front of the ship.  From
here, you can aim for the alcove high up in the room.  You can shoot the Gold
Skulltula from here with the Longshot, and take it's token.  If you like, you
can also use the Scarecrow's Song to pull yourself over to the alcove.

subject: Gold Skulltula #5 [GS086]
text: Gold Skulltula #5 [GS086] is found behind the trio of flaming skulls in the room with three flaming skulls, requiring the Hookshot or Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Gold Skulltula #5 [GS086]
Found: Behind the trio of flaming skulls in the room with the trio of flaming
skulls
Requires: Hookshot OR Longshot

subject: Gold Skulltula #5 [GS086]
text: In the room near the end of the dungeon with three flaming skulls, kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall behind them and collect its token using the Hookshot or Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Find the room near the end of the dungeon with THREE flaming skulls.  The Gold
Skulltula is on the wall behind the trio of flaming skulls.  Use the
Hookshot/Longshot to kill it and take it's token.
